notes: Solving mysteries is logic work, so Puzzle leads, but the neighbourhood you traverse and the missing items you hunt down are real Adventure work, so it is named second and contributes discovery alcoves for the places items hide. Shape is puzzle-open — cases staged across an unenclosed space, here a suburban neighbourhood rather than the row's plaza or garden — with clue facades, evidence slots, and solve gates from the Open-Air Puzzle preset, plus gate-progression because each solved case unlocks the next. With no user to ask, I decided two things: the cases are staged outdoors across yards, streets and the park, so the build stays P0 and enterable house interiors are deferred as a P3 upgrade rather than assumed; and the neighbours are present as ambient population, since a mystery about a neighbourhood needs residents and witnesses to be about.
